title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 069
review_goal: Differentiate keyboard, lantern, and laptop variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Keyboard panel with six upper key dots above one long lower bar
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a keyboard panel with dot keys above one long bottom bar.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the wired keyboard when the top should grow one cable curl and the keys become lines.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot arranges six small key dots over one long bar inside the keyboard frame.

items.depicts_observation: Keyboard panel with two horizontal key bars and one cable curl above
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a keyboard panel with line keys and a small cable curl above it.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the key dot keyboard when the upper keys should remain dot shaped.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces the dot keys with bars and adds one short cable curl on the top edge.

items.depicts_observation: Round lantern frame with one centered inner leaf and two lower tassel lines
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a rounded lantern with an inner leaf form and tassels below.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the tall lantern when the body should stretch into vertical bars.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot forms the lantern from a rounded outer frame around one centered inner leaf.

items.depicts_observation: Tall lantern frame with three vertical bars and two lower tassel lines
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a vertical lantern built from tall inner bar segments.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the round lantern when the body should wrap around one leaf shaped center.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot stretches the lantern into a tall body with parallel vertical bar segments.

items.depicts_observation: Laptop screen frame above one straight base line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a laptop with a flat base line under the open screen frame.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the curved base laptop when the lower platform should bow upward.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a simple open screen resting on one straight base line.
